purpose: Deterministic baseline for Structural Completeness only. Decision Quality remains evaluated by human labels and LLM outputs because it requires semantic judgement.

rule_definitions.C1: first heading or first non-empty line has at least three alphanumeric tokens and is not a generic template/index title
rule_definitions.C3: decision-driver, force, constraint, criterion, requirement, or consideration heading/keyword present
rule_definitions.C4: at least two option/alternative markers, or an options/alternatives section with repeated option terminology
rule_definitions.C5: decision/outcome wording plus because/therefore/so that/rationale/reason/justification wording
rule_definitions.C6: consequence, positive/negative consequence, pro/con, trade-off, tradeoff, or implication wording present

hybrid_rule_sc_plus_llm_dq.note: Hybrid predictions use deterministic rule_sc_class and each LLM row's predicted_dq_class. Older raw results must be rerun if they do not contain predicted_dq_class.
